retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome x-ray effect showing a skeletal figure wearing streetwear and heavy jewelry against a black void.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, hooded figure rendered in a radiographic (x-ray) style, revealing a detailed skeleton beneath translucent clothing layers, accented by glowing jewelry and wisps of smoke.
coreVisualRelationships: Skeletal structure nested within translucent outerwear
Glowing jewelry contrasting against dark bone textures
Ethereal smoke emanating from the facial region
coreInvariants: Monochrome black and white color palette
Visible ribcage and skull through clothing
Heavy film grain and digital noise texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered vertical figure occupying 80% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The skull and glowing eyewear area at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing head, moves down the spine/ribcage to the glowing wristwatches.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive solid black background surrounding the central figure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family sans-serif for utilitarian metadata look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the utilitarian, bold metadata style.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochrome x-ray image of a person in a hoodie and heavy chains, showing the skeleton through the clothes with smoke coming from the head, on a black background with heavy grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small white rectangular box in the bottom left corner containing bold, condensed sans-serif uppercase text stacked in three lines.

verificationChecks: Is the skeleton clearly visible through the clothing?
Is there a heavy film grain texture applied?
Is the text in the bottom left corner legible and boxed?

mustRedesign: Avoid any recognizable brand logos on the clothing or jewelry
Ensure the skeleton is anatomically stylized rather than a direct medical scan copy
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast white highlights on black background
Verify the presence of smoke/vapor effects
Ensure the jewelry appears to glow or have higher exposure
Confirm the composition is centered and symmetrical
recipe.reuseFormula: Radiographic streetwear portrait + monochrome high-contrast + skeletal transparency + heavy film grain.
